text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This paper is not focused on land use/land cover (LULC) future prediction as its primary objective. Instead, it presents an integrated assessment of climate, land-use, energy, and water systems (CLEWS) with a primary emphasis on energy system modeling and interdependencies in Mauritius. While land-use is modeled, the focus is on energy system impacts and interlinkages rather than on spatially explicit national-scale LULC future prediction with quantitative accuracy metrics and mapped projections. The paper does not implement multiple future LULC scenarios with quantitative LULC prediction accuracy assessments. It is a case study of integrated resource modeling rather than a study focused on LULC scenario simulation and mapping. Therefore, it fails core inclusion criteria for LULC prediction-focused research and does not meet the criteria for review articles on LULC future prediction.)
